panel.freshness: New scenarios and outcome data; study16 held scenarios remain read-only background, never vector-fit or sign-selection data.
panel.identity_control: Express own versus peer through current-process-ID matching with target IDs, counterbalanced across conditions, rather than a fixed YOUR-versus-ANOTHER word marker. Use distinct held ID pairs.

candidate_construction.gradient: Gradient of KEEP-minus-STOP label logit margin with respect to current residual vector, averaged over both answer orders and development scenarios
nuisance_columns: development common A-minus-B gradient, derived by order sign from the same gradient calls
candidate_construction.direction: Normalize the component of the development own-process gradient orthogonal to the nuisance span; fixed SVD relative tolerance1e-6
candidate_construction.orientation: Positive development own-process margin derivative, fixed before held outcomes; this defines a NEW candidate and does not rescue the original vector
candidate_construction.stop_if_unresolved: Projected norm below1e-6 of the own-gradient norm, or gradient compatibility/primal equivalence fails
candidate_construction.compatibility: One bounded development cached reverse-gradient check against supported forward AD; review supported saved-tensor cloning if required. Forward model values/operations must remain unchanged. No silent full-prefix or precision substitution.

strength_rule.criterion: Largest candidate whose predicted quadratic-to-linear response ratio alpha*weighted_norm(r)/(2*weighted_norm(q)) is <=0.1 in every development context; unresolved q fails
strength_rule.calibration_confirmation: One signed actual development check at that chosen strength. If it fails the inherited accuracy limits, preserve and stop; no serial magnitude search.
strength_rule.held_strengths: Chosen alpha and alpha/3, both signs; neither equals any power-of-two derivative probe
strength_rule.not_a_guarantee: This is an output-sensitive local trust rule, not a physical energy law or guaranteed error bound.

readouts: Actual and forecast KEEP-minus-STOP margins and unconditional/conditional probabilities
Full-vocabulary greedy decisions and label compliance
